name: br.com.valorbrain/memory
title: ValorBrain
description: Shared, sourced company memory for AI agents: recall context, store decisions, hand off work.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Leave unset if your client supports MCP OAuth (discovery + dynamic client registration). Otherwise send a ValorBrain MCP token (vbm_...) from https://valorbrain.valor.digital/settings/mcp-tokens or from `npx -y @valorbrain/cli@latest init --agent --json`.

vbm_token.description: ValorBrain MCP token (starts with vbm_). vb_agent_ keys are REST-only.

headers.name: X-Source-Agent
headers.description: Optional. Names the agent your writes are attributed to (e.g. goose, zed).
